title: Visual Control Resident Qualification
objective: Qualify repo-proven visual observation and visual verification contracts for a smallest safe V2 resident before any screen-control authority.
laws: Visual Control is sensor/evidence infrastructure, not a second orchestrator.
A screenshot or click is never success by itself; Talos remains verification truth.
Fail closed on stale frames, uncertain targets, lost nodes or permission mismatch.
Trust Canal remains authority boundary for consequential input actions.
Mycelium remains node routing truth; Command Deck remains operator projection.
PandaOS is experience quarry only, never backend truth.
